'''Alesune Chulin''' is the ''[[shatayan]]'' of [[Fal Moran]] Palace.

==Appearance==
She is slim and fiery, and has long black hair with two thin white streaks.

==Activities==
Alesune Chulin is part of King [[Easar Togita]]'s escort to the meeting of the [[Borderland]] rulers.
